website.notes: Official About page (served at pdffiller.com/en/about.htm, titled 'About airSlate | pdfFiller'). Mission: 'Empowering anyone to digitally transform document workflows'. Headline stats: over 100 million users worldwide; 900 employees; 5 offices; 40+ integrations; 85,000 state-specific legal forms; 500 marketplace vendors. Values: Delivering the WOW factor; Excellence through evidence; Growth with purpose; Empowering others. Milestones timeline: 2008 first build of the PDF Editor released to the public; 2009 pdfFiller surpasses 3,000 users; 2011 team 1 to 15, first Boston office; 2012 10,000 customers; 2013 e-signature product added; 2015 over 6 million users; 2016 100 employees and 1% charity pledge; 2017 signNow added to portfolio; 2019 airSlate workflow automation platform launched; 2021 product portfolio services over 100 million users with 900 employees in five global offices; 2022 acquires DocHub and reaches unicorn status. Product suite named on page: airSlate no-code workflow automation, signNow eSignature, pdfFiller PDF creator/editor, US Legal Forms library. Compliance badges: SOC 2 Type II, CCPA, HIPAA, GDPR, PCI DSS. Note: https://www.airslate.com/about returned a JavaScript-only shell with no extractable body text on plain fetch, so the pdffiller.com About page was used as the official-source substitute.

reviews.notes: Glassdoor: 3.6/5 from 119 reviews, 56% would recommend; subratings 3.8 work-life balance, 3.6 culture and values, 3.5 career opportunities, 3.6 compensation and benefits. Recent positive engineering review (Software Engineer, 2026-08-03) cites meaningful code reviews, attention to tests and architecture, initiative supported, flexible schedule, remote work, timely compensation. Recurring negatives across reviews (2024-2026): frequent layoffs/restructuring and IPO-driven cost cutting, below-market salary, slow promotion path, political stakeholder tension, legacy PHP alongside modern stack. Indeed shows 19 reviews with similar mixed picture. Reviews are anonymous self-reports: treat as sentiment leads, not facts about the specific pdfFiller team.

linkedin.notes: LinkedIn company page: ~817 employees (size band 501-1000, monthly growth +0.9%), privately held, HQ Brookline, Massachusetts, founded 2006 (product launched 2008 as pdfFiller), homepage airslate.com, ~$104.8M annual revenue, workforce distributed across 23-24 countries including Ukraine, Poland, United States, Philippines, Spain; ~14,211 followers. Third-party aggregators give differing headcounts (highperformr 931; profile snippets 400-500 with -10% YoY), so treat total headcount as a range of roughly 400-930 depending on source and date. No airSlate personal connections of the candidate identified in this pass.

media.notes: Forbes 2022-09-14: airSlate headquartered in Boston, began life as PDFFiller in 2008, founded by Vadim Yasinovsky, Borya Shakhnovich joined as CEO and expanded it into document workflow. General Catalyst 2021-01-12 launch story: $40M investment, company over 800 employees at the time, 700,000+ paying customers, roughly $100M ARR, product suite built from pdfFiller and signNow. Kyiv Post 2021-01-15: $40M raise; founded in Ukraine in 2008 under the PDF Filler name; US-based since 2011. Boston Business Journal 2025-10-23: airSlate cut 170 jobs worldwide (had about 80 employees in Boston in 2023). AIN 2022-06-22: reached $1.25B valuation (unicorn) in 2022. Company blogs/aggregators note rebrand from PDFfiller to airSlate around 2019 and a leadership change in July 2025 with Vadim Yasinovsky returning as CEO.
